name: Navigation and Guidance Subsystem
description: Provides GPS and inertial navigation plus route guidance

name: Fly-By-Wire Flight Control Subsystem
description: Closed-loop flight stability and control surface actuation

name: Vehicle Management Subsystem
description: Aggregates data and composes flight display products

name: Flight Display Subsystem
description: Primary and multifunction cockpit display rendering

name: INS Unit
description: Three gyros and three accelerometers provide inertial frame reference

name: Flight Director
description: Uses waypoints to compute route-following guidance commands

name: Servo Actuator Cluster
description: Executes control-surface movement and returns feedback

name: Vehicle Management Computer
description: Concentrates avionics data and builds display feeds

name: GPS Position Feed
description: GPS position and velocity words from receiver to flight director

name: Inertial Reference Feed
description: Gyro rates and accelerometer axes from INS to flight control computer

name: Guidance Command Bus
description: Lateral and vertical setpoints from flight director to FCC crossing guidance-control partition

name: Actuator Command Bus
description: Discrete surface commands from FCC to servo cluster crossing digital-actuation boundary

name: Servo Feedback Bus
description: Analog surface position and rate feedback from servo cluster to FCC crossing actuation-sensing boundary

name: FCC State Bus
description: FCC mode flags and fault summary to vehicle management computer

name: Display Video Bus
description: Composited video frames and annunciations from VMC to primary flight display

name: Health Snapshot Bus
description: System health and network status broadcast from VMC to flight director
